topic.title: Diff Visual Check
topic.shortdesc: Fixture for eyeballing the "Compare with Git Version" rendering. Each section is a checkpoint for one change type; the paired "after" edit (see the next commit to this file, or the working copy) is what produces the diff.

section.title: 0. Unchanged control
section.p: This paragraph is byte-for-byte identical in both versions. It should render as a plain, untinted row on both sides -- the straight edge against which every other row is judged.

section.title: 1. Modified paragraph (word-level)
section.p: The report aggregates telemetry from every connected sensor, computes rolling averages over a five minute window, and raises an alert when a reading crosses the configured threshold for three consecutive samples.

section.title: 2. Removed block
section.p: This whole paragraph exists only in the older version, so in the diff it should appear on the left with a struck-through tint and an empty placeholder on the right.

section.title: 3. Added section
section.p: The paragraph that the newer version introduces below this heading should surface as a fully tinted added block, with an empty placeholder on the base side.

ul.li: Wipe the contact surface with a dry cloth.
Do not use alcohol or abrasive cleaners.
Power the device off before cleaning.
Reattach the cover once it is fully dry.

section.title: 6. 中文段落（词级修改）
section.p: 系统在检测到异常时会自动记录日志，并将诊断信息上传到云端服务器。

note.p: Failing to ground the chassis before opening the panel may damage the board.
